---
title: "GB7CAM Network Graph"
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
execute:
  echo: false
---

<div id="controls" style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;">
  <input id="filter" placeholder="Filter node e.g. GB7FCI" style="padding:6px;width:220px;">
  <label style="color:#c9d1d9;font-family:sans-serif;">
    <input type="checkbox" id="opMode">
    Operator mode
  </label>
</div>

<div id="network" style="height: 90vh; border: 1px solid #222; background: #0b0f14;"></div>

<script src="https://unpkg.com/vis-network/standalone/umd/vis-network.min.js"></script>

<script>
const API = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk/graph";

let network;
let nodesDS;
let edgesDS;
let fullData;

/* ----------------------------
   PORT COLOURS (your real mapping)
---------------------------- */
function portColor(port) {
  switch(String(port)) {
    case "1": return "#2ecc71"; // RF green
    case "2": return "#f1c40f"; // telnet amber
    case "3": return "#3498db"; // AXIP blue
    default:  return "#95a5a6";
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   NODE COLOURS (family-based)
---------------------------- */
function nodeColor(id) {
  if (id.startsWith("GB7CAM")) return "#ff6b6b"; // core
  if (id.startsWith("GB7")) return "#4dabf7";     // UK infra
  if (id.startsWith("M7") || id.startsWith("2E1")) return "#51cf66";
  if (id.startsWith("KC2") || id.startsWith("N2") || id.startsWith("ZL")) return "#ffd43b";
  return "#adb5bd";
}

/* ----------------------------
   EDGE WIDTH
---------------------------- */
function qualityWidth(q) {
  if (!q) return 1;
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(8, q / 45));
}

/* ----------------------------
   BUILD NEIGHBOUR MAP
---------------------------- */
function buildAdj(edges) {
  const adj = new Map();

  function add(a,b){
    if(!adj.has(a)) adj.set(a,new Set());
    adj.get(a).add(b);
  }

  edges.forEach(e => {
    add(e.source, e.target);
    add(e.target, e.source);
  });

  return adj;
}

/* ----------------------------
   FILTER LOGIC (FIXED)
   - keeps 1-hop neighbours
---------------------------- */
function computeVisible(data, filterText, opMode) {

  const nodes = new Map();
  const adj = buildAdj(data.edges || []);

  const match = (id, alias) => {
    const t = filterText.toUpperCase();
    return id.includes(t) || (alias||"").toUpperCase().includes(t);
  };

  let seed = new Set();

  if (filterText) {
    data.nodes.forEach(n => {
      if (match(n.id, n.alias)) seed.add(n.id);
    });
  }

  // operator mode = remove isolates
  if (opMode && seed.size === 0) {
    data.nodes.forEach(n => seed.add(n.id));
  }

  // expand neighbours (THIS FIXES YOUR ISSUE)
  let visible = new Set(seed);

  seed.forEach(id => {
    (adj.get(id) || []).forEach(n => visible.add(n));
  });

  // if no filter, show all
  if (!filterText && !opMode) {
    data.nodes.forEach(n => visible.add(n.id));
  }

  return visible;
}

/* ----------------------------
   LOAD + RENDER
---------------------------- */
async function load() {

  const res = await fetch(API);
  fullData = await res.json();

  const nodeMap = new Map();

  // nodes
  (fullData.nodes || []).forEach(n => {
    nodeMap.set(n.id, {
      id: n.id,
      label: `${n.id}\n${n.alias || ""}`,
      color: nodeColor(n.id)
    });
  });

  // ensure edge endpoints exist (CRITICAL FIX)
  (fullData.edges || []).forEach(e => {
    if (!nodeMap.has(e.source)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.source, {
        id: e.source,
        label: e.source,
        color: nodeColor(e.source)
      });
    }
    if (!nodeMap.has(e.target)) {
      nodeMap.set(e.target, {
        id: e.target,
        label: e.target,
        color: nodeColor(e.target)
      });
    }
  });

  nodesDS = new vis.DataSet([...nodeMap.values()]);

  edgesDS = new vis.DataSet(
    (fullData.edges || []).map((e, i) => ({
      id: i,
      from: e.source,
      to: e.target,
      arrows: "to",
      width: qualityWidth(e.quality),
      label: e.quality ? String(e.quality) : "",
      color: {
        color: portColor(e.port),
        highlight: "#ffffff"
      },
      dashes: e.quality === 0,
      font: { color: "#c9d1d9", size: 10 },
      shadow: e.state === "Active"
    }))
  );

  network = new vis.Network(
    document.getElementById("network"),
    { nodes: nodesDS, edges: edgesDS },
    {
      physics: {
        stabilization: true,
        barnesHut: {
          gravitationalConstant: -9000,
          springLength: 140
        }
      },
      nodes: {
        shape: "dot",
        size: 14,
        font: { color: "#e6edf3" },
        borderWidth: 1
      },
      edges: {
        smooth: { type: "dynamic" }
      }
    }
  );

  setupUI();
}

/* ----------------------------
   APPLY FILTER
---------------------------- */
function applyFilter() {

  const filterText = document.getElementById("filter").value;
  const opMode = document.getElementById("opMode").checked;

  const visible = computeVisible(fullData, filterText, opMode);

  nodesDS.forEach(n => {
    nodesDS.update({
      id: n.id,
      hidden: !visible.has(n.id)
    });
  });

  edgesDS.forEach(e => {
    const show =
      visible.has(e.from) &&
      visible.has(e.to);

    edgesDS.update({
      id: e.id,
      hidden: !show
    });
  });
}

/* ----------------------------
   UI
---------------------------- */
function setupUI() {
  document.getElementById("filter").addEventListener("input", applyFilter);
  document.getElementById("opMode").addEventListener("change", applyFilter);
}

load();
</script>
